ARABIC — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: ARABIC
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In ARABIC, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Mix random languages with no purpose
   B. Only memorise without using the language
   C. Avoid speaking to classmates
   D. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day

2. When practising Interactive Speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Interactive Speaking.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Interactive Speaking.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Interactive Speaking.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Interactive Speaking.

3. When practising Listening for Information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Listening for Information.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for Information.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Information.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Listening for Information.

4. When practising Active Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Active Listening.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Active Listening.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Active Listening.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Active Listening.

5. When practising Reading Fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading Fluency.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Reading Fluency.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Reading Fluency.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Reading Fluency.

6. When practising Oral Expression, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Oral Expression.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Oral Expression.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Oral Expression.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Oral Expression.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
7. In three clear sentences, explain Reading Fluency: Pronunciation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

8. In three clear sentences, explain Reading for Information and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

9. In three clear sentences, explain Reading for Information and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

10. In three clear sentences, explain Reading Aloud: Dialogue and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day

2. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Interactive Speaking.

3. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Information.

4. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Active Listening.

5. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading Fluency.

6. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Oral Expression.

7. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Reading Fluency: Pronunciation; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

8. (4 marks)

9. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Reading for Information; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

10. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Reading Aloud: Dialogue; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
